question_text:
Identify and rectify a misconfigured VPC route table exposing private subnets (Cloud Infrastructure & Virtual Networks (VPC, Subnets)).

### Defective Code:
```hcl
# Terraform Configuration Defect
resource "aws_route_table" "private_rt_16" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
  # Defect: Private subnet routes 0.0.0.0/0 to IGW instead of NAT Gateway
  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.gw.id
  }
}
```

### Reported Anomaly / Error:
Security vulnerability: Private database subnets inadvertently exposed to public internet ingress in Cloud Infrastructure & Virtual Networks (VPC, Subnets).

Identify the root cause of the defect and provide the corrected code snippet with rationale.
answer_explanation: Routing private subnets directly to an Internet Gateway violates network isolation. Private subnets must route internet egress through a NAT Gateway.
sample_input: Defective snippet causing runtime failure or logical discrepancy.
expected_output: Corrected code snippet passing all edge conditions.

criteria.name: Root Cause Identification
criteria.description: Accurately identifies the exact line and logic error causing failure.

criteria.name: Remediation Precision
criteria.description: Provides clean fix without side effects or performance regressions.

criteria.name: Technical Rationale
criteria.description: Explains underlying runtime or structural mechanics clearly.
